title: Floating library brings books to island schools
text:
By Dewi Anggraini

A wooden boat carrying more than 2,000 books has begun regular visits to five small islands off the coast of Sulawesi, giving hundreds of children the chance to use a library for the first time.

The boat, called Pustaka Laut (Sea Library), was launched last month by a team of volunteers led by retired teacher Pak Haris Mandala. Every two weeks, it sails from the mainland and spends a day moored at each island. Children climb aboard to choose books and listen to stories, and each child may borrow up to three books until the next visit.

“On these islands, the nearest bookshop is a three-hour boat ride away,” said Pak Haris. “Many children had never held a book that was not a school textbook. Now they wait on the jetty for us, waving.”

The idea began two years ago, when Pak Haris visited a primary school on one of the islands and found a single shelf of old, damaged books. He started collecting donations from friends, and soon schools and families across the region were sending books. A local boat builder agreed to repair an old fishing boat at a lower price, and the volunteers painted it bright blue and yellow.

Teachers say the visits are already making a difference. Ibu Rahmi, who teaches at one of the island schools, said that her pupils are reading more often and talking about stories in class. “One girl has read every animal book on the boat,” she said. “Now she wants us to find more!”

However, the project faces challenges. During the wet season, rough seas sometimes make the crossing unsafe, and the boat has to stay in the harbour. Books can also be damaged by sea spray and damp air, so the volunteers keep them in sealed plastic boxes and check them after every trip.

The team now hopes to raise enough money for a second boat, as well as tablets loaded with audiobooks for children who are still learning to read.

Anyone who would like to donate books in good condition can contact the Pustaka Laut team through the harbour office.
